title: Unit Event — That day, the Sky was Far Away — Episode2 Me Back Then

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away
meta.Event Outline: Shiho feels a great sense of fulfillment after Leo/need successfully reaches its ticket quota and performs in perfect sync for the audience. She recalls the time she spent on her own back in junior high.

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, here's to our show yesterday going amazingly well...! Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Try not to spill any juice, alright, you two?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, Rin's totally gonna trip and fall at some point.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'll be fine!
See? My drink's on my desk and I'm using a straw!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, Len, raise your glass! Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, cheers.
Hey, this juice is pretty good...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, a rooftop afterparty turned out to be such a great idea.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki suggested it on our way home yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when we decided to bring some food and drinks to celebrate...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your apple pies really never disappoint, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know they're good, Miku, but leave some for the rest of us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-I've only had a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm sorry.
You seemed to be really enjoying yourself so...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Everything okay, KAITO?
What are you doing all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh...
N-Nothing in particular...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's just...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-It's not that I don't like parties or anything. I'm just not used to them is all...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I usually play or perform by myself, so I have a hard time figuring what to do in these sorts of situations when everyone's involved...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Actually, I think I understand how you feel. There was a time when I spent a lot of time by myself...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Ever since I was little, I've always been a bit of a lone wolf when it comes to doing the things I want.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, the flip side of that involved me not being great at interacting with others...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
But I think I can empathize...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm not gonna lie...
Crowds and parties really aren't my thing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But things are different for me here...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because Ichika and the girls mean so much to you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our show yesterday even felt like a dream to me. For a moment there, I couldn't believe that I was actually playing in a band with them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But during junior high, I put a lot of distance between myself and the others because of my personality.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why playing in a band together like this feels dreamlike at times...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Shiiihhooo!!
You've gotta try these! They're so crispy!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wah!
Wh-What is it, Saki? They're just chips, right...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She wants you to try this new flavor of potato chips, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, is that what this is about...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm?
What were you and Shiho talking about, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh? Um...
What were we talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait! Is it supposed to be a secret?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
N-No, not really...
Shiho was just telling me about herself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About yourself?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I was just telling him how I didn't expect to be playing in a band with all of you like before.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Like before?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
During junior high...
When all I did was play my bass by myself.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Junior high school was when...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Ichika, Honami...
You don't need to look so concerned. Not now at least.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If it's alright with you, Shiho, can you tell me more about what happened back then...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want to know more because I really didn't get to go to school much during junior high...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I kinda want to hear more about you during that time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Me... Back then...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But telling her about that time won't really...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear as well...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me too.
That goes for everyone, including you, Shiho. I want to know more about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That is, as long as you're okay with it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. You don't have to if you're not comfortable with it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But I'd like to hear someday as well...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe sharing what happened in the past will bring you all closer together and become a great source of strength...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay...
I've never really had the chance to talk about what happened back then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So I'll do that now.
When I was in junior high...
